convert_ldm_checkpoint_to_diffusers: convert an LDM checkpoint to a diffusers UNet3DConditionModel format using the CLI with --checkpoint_path and --dump_path
convert_ldm_unet_checkpoint_function: call convert_ldm_unet_checkpoint with a state dict and config to return a converted diffusers checkpoint
assign_weights_to_checkpoint: use assign_to_checkpoint to map old checkpoint weights to new paths with attention splitting and replacements
rename_resnet_layer_paths: use renew_resnet_paths to update old resnet layer names to the new diffusers naming scheme
shave_path_segments: use shave_segments to remove prefix or suffix segments from a dotted layer path string
